title: PluginConfig
description: User's plugin configuration, stored at .argus/config.yaml in the repo. Read by every skill at invocation. Plugin-v2 MVP fields only. If file missing, skills use defaults + prompt user to create.

locale.description: Language for prompts, AskUserQuestion options, and generated output. Overrides skill defaults.

boss.description: Configured stakeholder for the boss step of /argus:review. Optional — the skill offers a generic decision-owner review if absent. SEAT-FIRST (O3 방3, R42): the review's value comes from the seat — role, what it owns, its goals and authority — never from a personality type. A tone skin is optional coloring only.

role.description: The SEAT — what chair this stakeholder sits in. Default '팀장' (ko) / 'Team Lead' (en). The primary field: concerns must be anchored here.

owns.description: What this seat is accountable for — its objective function (e.g. '팀 분기 로드맵과 서비스 안정성', 'revenue & renewals'). Optional but the single highest-value field.

goals.description: Current priorities of the seat (e.g. '이번 분기 신뢰성 사고 0건, 일정 준수'). Optional.

authority.description: What this seat can approve or refuse, and what it must escalate (e.g. '머지·배포 승인, 일정 조정; 예산·인사는 상신'). Optional — the review must speak only within it.

name.description: Display name of the boss. e.g., '박 팀장' or 'Alex'. Can be free-form.

gender.description: Affects prompt pronouns in Korean mode.

tone.description: OPTIONAL voice skin — one of the 16 tone presets in data/boss-types.yaml. Colors HOW the review speaks; never the SOURCE of a concern (R42: type contributed 0/5 value; the seat carried all of it).

mbti_code.description: LEGACY alias of `tone` — kept so pre-O3 configs keep their voice. Read as a tone skin only; `tone` wins when both are set.

max_agents_override.description: Override stakes-based agent count limit. Use with care.

preferred_agents.description: Agent IDs to prefer when scores are close. Soft signal.

commit_sessions.description: If true, /argus:versions suggests committing .argus/sessions/ changes at phase=complete.
